task_language: Close the electric kettle lid and turn on the electric kettle.
correction_semantics: The robot has been stuck near the kettle handle/body again. Whenever this happens, try to make the robot first go away from the handle / kettle a bit and then start going down towards the lever. Because if you try to go down when the gripper is stuck against the handle/body of the kettle, it won't be able to go down.

selection.reason: Plan 45 is the only option that moves the gripper away from the kettle in the negative x direction before starting to move down, as requested by the operator.
